description: Hi Team Sandra! Twenty Days to go and the only way for Sandra to win this race is for us to use our relationships—relational organizing. This means you, her biggest supporters, should, could, and would you... email, call, text, and post about her upcoming events and needs and calls to action? You can find everything on this easy linktree site. Linktree is evergreen so it's always being updated with links and flyers for the latest activities that we have coming up. title: 20 Days to Go!
